ObjectStates.LuaScript:
function onLoad()
params = {
click_function = "rotate",
function_owner = self,
label = "",
position = {0, 0, 0},
rotation = {0, 180, 0},
width = 300,
height = 300,
font_size = 0,
color = {0, 0, 0},
font_color = {1, 1, 1},
}
self.createButton(params)
end

local pointer = getObjectFromGUID("1af263")

function rotate()
local threshold = 0.01
local av = pointer.getAngularVelocity()
if math.abs(av.x) < threshold and math.abs(av.y) < threshold and math.abs(av.z) < threshold then
pointer.setRotationSmooth(pointer.getRotation()+Vector(0,120,0))
end
end

ObjectStates.Name: Custom_Assetbundle
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
local turnSkipPlayer
local colorLocked

function onLoad(saved_state)
    saved_state = JSON.decode(saved_state)
    if saved_state == "" then
        turnSkipPlayer = nil
        self.setColorTint({0.5, 0.5, 0.5})
        colorLocked = false
    else
        assignColor(saved_state["turnSkipPlayer"])
        colorLocked = saved_state["turnSkipPlayer"]
    end
    self.addContextMenuItem("Reset All", unskipAll)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Color Lock", toggleColorLock)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Spawn For Players", spawnForEachSeatedPlayer)
end

function onSave()
    local state_to_save = {
    turnSkipPlayer = turnSkipPlayer,
    colorLocked = colorLocked,
    }
    return JSON.encode(state_to_save)
end

-- Set turnSkipPlayer color to track
function onPickUp(color)
    if not colorLocked then
        assignColor(color)
    end
end

function onObjectEnterZone(zone, object)

    if not colorLocked and zone.type == "Hand" and object == self then

        assignColor(zone.getValue())
    end
end


-- If it's turnSkipPlayer's turn and the token is flipped, skip their turn
function onPlayerTurn(player)
	if player == nil then return end
    if turnSkipPlayer == player.color and self.is_face_down then
        if getIfAllSkipped() then
            broadcastToAll("All turns have been skipped!")
        else
            broadcastToAll("Skipping " .. player.steam_name .. "'s turn.", player.color)
            Wait.frames(skipTurn, 2)
--            broadcastToAll(">implied skip", player.color)
        end
    end
end

function skipTurn()
    Turns.turn_color = Turns.getNextTurnColor()
end

function unskipAll(player, position, object)
    for i, object in ipairs(getObjectsWithTag("Turn Skipper")) do
        if object.is_face_down then
            object.flip()
        end
    end
end

function countSkipperButtons()
    local count = 0
    for i, object in ipairs(getObjectsWithTag("Turn Skipper")) do
        count = count + 1
    end
    return count
end

function countSeatedPlayers()
    seatedPlayers = getSeatedPlayers()
    return #seatedPlayers
end

function getIfAllSkipped()
    for i, object in ipairs(getObjectsWithTag("Turn Skipper")) do
        if not object.is_face_down then
            return false
        end
    end
    return countSkipperButtons() == countSeatedPlayers()
end

function toggleColorLock(player, position, object)
    colorLocked = not colorLocked
    local str
    if colorLocked then str = "Color locked!" else str = "Color unlocked!" end
    broadcastToColor(str, player, turnSkipPlayer)
end

function spawnForEachSeatedPlayer(pl, pos, obj)
    for i, player in ipairs(getSeatedPlayers()) do
        if Player[player].getHandCount() > 0 then
            local transform = Player[player].getHandTransform()
            transform["position"] = transform["position"] + 5 * transform["forward"]
            transform["position"]["y"] = 3
            local new_object = spawnObject({type = "Custom_Assetbundle",
                                            position = transform["position"],
                                            rotation = transform["rotation"]})
            new_object.script_code = self.script_code
            new_object.script_state = JSON.encode({turnSkipPlayer = player, colorLocked = true})
            new_object.addTag("Turn Skipper")
            new_object.setName("Turn Skipper")
            new_object.setCustomObject(self.getCustomObject())
            new_object.reload()
            self.destruct()
        end
    end
end

function initOnSpawn(player, lock_state)
    self.script_state = {
    turnSkipPlayer = player,
    colorLocked = lock_state,
    }
end

function assignColor(color)
    if color ~= nil then
        self.setColorTint(color)
        turnSkipPlayer = color
    end
end
